senses.gloss:
स्निग्धता स्निग्ध + ता (vb. स्निह्), f.
 1. Affection.
 2. Unctuousness.

स्निट् स्निट्, i. 10, Par.
 1. To go.
 2. To love (cf. स्निह्).

स्निह् स्निह्, i. 4, Par. (properly, To be viscous, easy to be attached to), To bear affection to, Śāk. 102, 6 (to this boy).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. स्निग्ध.
 1. Oily, unctuous, smooth, Rājat. 5, 319.
 2. Wet, Megh. 16 (Sch.),
 3. Resplendent, Vikr. d. 70 (कनक-निकष-, like a streak of pure gold).
 4. Agreeable, Megh. 65.
 5. Coarse.
 6. Thick, dense, Megh. 1.
 7. Cooling, emollient.
 8. Attached, Hit. ii. d. 151; kind, well affected, Man. 7, 32; 120; loving, Pañc. i. d. 317. m.
 1. A [] friend, Pañc. ii. d. 178.
 2. Two kinds of pine. f. धा, Marrow. n.
 1. Oil, Megh. 60.
 2. Beeswax.
 3. Light.
 4. Thickness.
 --† i. 10, Par. To be unctuous.
 --With अति अति, अतिस्निग्ध, Very smooth, Rām. 3, 49, 36.
 --With उप उप, Caus. To cause to love, to fascinate, Utt. Rāmac. 34, 18.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रस्निग्ध, Very oily, Śāk. d. 14.
